description_en:
Queries quality rules by paging.
Online version: v5.4.2
description_zh:
分页查询质量规则。
上线版本：v5.4.2
name: ListQualityRules

fields.help_en:
The rule effective status. Valid values:
ENABLE: enabled.
DISABLE: disabled
fields.help_zh: 规则生效状态: ENABLE 启用、DISABLE 禁用
fields.name: status_list

fields.help_en:
The rule type. Valid values:
CONSISTENT: consistency.
EFFECTIVE: validity.
TIMELINESE: timeliness.
ACCURATE: accuracy.
UNIQUENESS: uniqueness.
COMPLETENESS: completeness.
STABILITY: stability.
CUSTOM: custom
fields.help_zh: 规则类型: CONSISTENT 一致性，EFFECTIVE 有效性，TIMELINESE 时效性，ACCURATE 准确性，UNIQUENESS 唯一性，COMPLETENESS 完整性，STABILITY 稳定性，CUSTOM 自定义
fields.name: catalog_list

fields.help_en:
The rule strength. Valid values:
STRONG: strong.
WEAK: weak
fields.help_zh: 规则强度: STRONG 强、WEAK 弱
fields.name: rule_strength_list

fields.help_en:
The trial run validation result. Valid values:
NOT_RUN: not executed.
WAITING: waiting for execution.
RUNNING: executing.
PASS: passed.
NOT_PASS: not passed.
FAILED: execution failed.
OFFLINE: offline. The task needs to be restarted.
CANCEL: task canceled.
TIMEOUT: task timed out
fields.help_zh: 规则试跑校验结果: NOT_RUN 未执行、WAITING 等待执行、RUNNING 执行中、PASS 通过、NOT_PASS 不通过、FAILED 执行失败、OFFLINE 掉线,需要重新拉起、CANCEL 任务取消、TIMEOUT 任务超时
fields.name: test_run_task_validate_result_list

fields.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:
NOT_RUN: not executed.
WAITING: waiting.
RUNNING: executing.
SUCCESS: execution succeeded.
FAILED: execution failed.
CANCEL: canceled.
TIMEOUT: timed out.
OFFLINE: offline
fields.help_zh: 任务状态: NOT_RUN 未执行、WAITING 等待中、RUNNING 执行中、SUCCESS 执行成功、FAILED 执行失败、CANCEL 取消、TIMEOUT 超时、OFFLINE 离线
fields.name: test_run_task_status_list

fields.help_en: The search keyword for filtering. Supports searching by rule name and validation object
fields.help_zh: 搜索词筛选，支持规则名称和校验对象搜索
fields.name: keyword

fields.help_en: The number of records per page. Default value: 20
fields.name: page_size
